Issue #16 is a standalone easy-call and continuation of the prepared HHH-20980 fix. At pinned main 4cabe417c868b343fa458a6e42b1da7a4813ec52, StandardLockingSupports.parameterized(..., boolean supportsInnerJoins, TransactionConcurrencyResolver) calls the seven-argument LockingSupportParameterized constructor, whose boolean is readsWaitForUncommittedWrites and which forces inner-join support true. AltibaseDialect supplies false; QueryLockingManagedEntityTest consumes this metadata for pessimistic streamed joins.

Two-way: select the existing eight-argument constructor without adding API or changing schemas. Pass supportsInnerJoins twice: first to correct join support, second to preserve the old observable legacy read-wait value. Preserve resolver identity, omitted-flag defaults, deprecated factory behavior and other metadata.

Reuse six prepared public-factory contract tests and five compatibility tests. Prior isolated results are not current-project validation. Establish genuine current-project RED then GREEN via focused JDK 25 GitHub Actions, followed by locking-unit neighbors, QueryLockingManagedEntityTest on H2 and formatChecks. This does not establish Altibase runtime or full database-matrix coverage.

Read CONTRIBUTING.md, README.adoc, classification-tooling.adoc and current canonical coding standards including the scoped Hibernate maintainer checklist. Target CONTEXT.md and .sandcastle/CODING_STANDARDS.md are absent. Relevant lessons are explicit option alternatives, smallest responsible-layer correction and preserving contracts; unrelated cache/provider lessons do not expand scope. Nearby tests use the same package and JUnit structure. There are no duplicates in this batch or existing HHH-20980 work branches/PRs. No source edits or runtime tests during this read-only Explore stage. Current-project reproduction, verification, actual review and clean publication preparation remain implementation-stage work.
